scenes.stage_direction: The room grows quieter as live contact approaches. The last call is real; physical reunion is still beyond this campaign.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I will not pay him to hide my own life.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The household will be asked to answer publicly too.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then we will see whether they can say Ethan's name when other people are listening.

metadata.evidence_summary: The threat loses its power over her decisions.
